parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A rectangular MDF door panel attached to the table cabinet section.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the internal storage compartment of the table.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A flat MDF panel forming the rear enclosure of the table cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and conceals the back of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical MDF panel forming the left side of the cabinet structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and connects to the bottom and back panels.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical MDF panel forming the right side of the cabinet structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and connects to the bottom and back panels.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bottom Panel
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal MDF panel forming the base of the cabinet section.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable foundation for the cabinet and supports internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
